title: S3 Advanced Features
description: Explore S3 replication, multipart upload, presigned URLs, S3 events, and lifecycle policies.

data.text: S3 offers many advanced features that help you build robust, automated, and efficient storage solutions. These include cross-Region replication, multipart uploads for large files, presigned URLs for temporary access, event notifications, and lifecycle policies for cost optimization.

Cross-Region Replication (CRR) automatically copies objects from a source bucket to a destination bucket in a different Region. This is useful for disaster recovery, compliance, and reducing latency for users in different parts of the world.

Multipart upload lets you upload large objects in parts. Each part can be uploaded independently, and if one part fails, you only need to retry that part. Presigned URLs generate temporary URLs that let others upload or download objects without needing AWS credentials.

S3 Event Notifications send messages to services like SNS, SQS, or Lambda when objects are created, deleted, or restored. Lifecycle policies automatically transition objects between storage classes or delete them after a certain time. This helps you optimize costs without manual effort.

data.title: Lifecycle Policy Actions
items: Transition objects to a cheaper storage class after a certain number of days.
Expire (delete) objects after a retention period.
Expire incomplete multipart uploads to save storage costs.
Expire old versions when versioning is enabled.

data.title: Generate a Presigned URL with Python/Boto3
data.content: Use Boto3 to generate a presigned URL that lets a user download an object for 1 hour.
data.code:
import boto3
from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

s3_client = boto3.client('s3', region_name='us-east-1')

try:
    url = s3_client.generate_presigned_url(
        'get_object',
        Params={'Bucket': 'my-bucket', 'Key': 'report.pdf'},
        ExpiresIn=3600
    )
    print(f"Presigned URL (valid for 1 hour): {url}")
except ClientError as e:
    print(f"Error generating URL: {e}")

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Cross-Region Replication copies objects between Regions for disaster recovery
Multipart upload makes large file uploads more reliable
Presigned URLs grant temporary access without sharing credentials
S3 Event Notifications trigger workflows when objects change
Lifecycle policies automate cost optimization by transitioning or deleting objects
